note: Re-judged 2026-11-02 by an independent auditor who authored none of the changes named. RFC 8955 Section 3: "Standard BGP policy mechanisms, such as UPDATE filtering by NLRI prefix as well as community matching, must apply to the Flow specification defined NLRI-type." d34463329d rewrote all four tagged units from plugin text input to wire UPDATEs judged by a compiled policychain over a registry holding the list and a match filter naming it (judgeWire, matchChain), the path the engine now runs. Community half: SAFI 133 and 134 FlowSpec-only UPDATEs (no IPv4 NLRI field) carrying 65001:100 must accept; 65001:666 beside 65001:100 and 64496:1 alone must reject with final accept, so the reject comes from the list's first match and implicit deny, not the final. Prefix half: ipv4/flow and flow-vpn destination 10.1.0.0/24 must accept with no MP_REACH NLRI drop; /25, 192.0.2.0/24, a rule with only a source component, and a mixed permitted/denied pair must reject. The old text case 'invalid' became 'no destination', its wire counterpart. Stronger than before: wire bytes and the real chain rather than plugin text. Still no daemon .ci drives a FlowSpec UPDATE through a configured filter. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
